{{Quote|Calling all units. Suspicious activity on Level 1315.|A [[Coruscant Underworld Police]] officer|<ref name="Catch a Jedi" />}}
'''Level 1315''' was a level of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], one thousand three hundred and fifteen levels from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] core. This held the location of a secret [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|warehouse]] where [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] had visited before acquiring a supply of [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]]. On this level, both [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were attacked by a [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who stole [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|Asajj Ventress' lightsabers]]. Here, Ahsoka was finally captured after being discovered next to Nano-droid canisters.<ref name="Catch a Jedi" />
